arxiv-2110-07429.title: 𝔼 k {\mathbb{E}}_{k} -pushouts and 𝔼 k + 1 {\mathbb{E}}_{k+1} -tensors Thanks: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. DMS-2105019
arxiv-2110-07429.creator: Michael A. Hill, Tyler Lawson
arxiv-2110-07429.description: Abstract . We prove a general result that relates certain pushouts of 𝔼 k {\mathbb{E}}_{k} -algebras to relative tensors over 𝔼 k + 1 {\mathbb{E}}_{k+1} -algebras. Specializations include a number of established results on classifying spaces, resolutions of modules, and (co)homology theories for ring spectra. The main results apply when the category in question has centralizers.

arxiv-2305-05247.title: Leveraging Generative AI Models for Synthetic Data Generation in Healthcare: Balancing Research and Privacy
arxiv-2305-05247.creator: Aryan Jadon, Shashank Kumar
arxiv-2305-05247.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of electronic health records and digital healthcare data has created a demand for data-driven insights to enhance patient outcomes, diagnostics, and treatments. However, using real patient data presents privacy and regulatory challenges, including compliance with HIPAA [ 1 ] and GDPR [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2401-15186.creator: Libor Barto, Silvia Butti, Alexandr Kazda, Caterina Viola, Stanislav Živný
arxiv-2401-15186.description: Abstract Following the success of the so-called algebraic approach to the study of decision constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs), exact optimization of valued CSPs, and most recently promise CSPs, we propose an algebraic framework for valued promise CSPs. To every valued promise CSP we associate an algebraic object, its so-called valued minion.

arxiv-2504-06542.title: Polygon : Symbolic Reasoning for SQL using Conflict-Driven Under-Approximation Search
arxiv-2504-06542.creator: Pinhan Zhao, Yuepeng Wang, Xinyu Wang
arxiv-2504-06542.description: Abstract . We present a novel symbolic reasoning engine for SQL which can efficiently generate an input I I for n n queries P 1 , ⋯ , P n P_{1},\cdots,P_{n} , such that their outputs on I I satisfy a given property (expressed in SMT).

arxiv-2510-15185.title: Bilateral Two-Parameter Mock Theta Functions and Related Applications
arxiv-2510-15185.creator: Chun WANG
arxiv-2510-15185.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate new relationships for bilateral series related to two-parameter mock theta functions, which lead to many identities concerning the bilateral mock theta functions. In addition, interesting relations between the classical mock theta functions and the bilateral series are also concluded.

pmc-11489095.title: The Arabidopsis U1 snRNP regulates mRNA 3′-end processing
pmc-11489095.creator: Anchilie F Mangilet, Joachim Weber, Sandra Schüler, Manon Adler, Eneza Yoeli Mjema, Paula Heilmann, Angie Herold, Monique Renneberg, Luise Nagel, Irina Droste-Borel, Samuel Streicher, Thomas Schmutzer, Gregor Rot, Boris Macek, Cornelius Schmidtke, Sascha Laubinger
pmc-11489095.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The removal of introns by the spliceosome is a key gene regulatory mechanism in eukaryotes, with the U1 snRNP subunit playing a crucial role in the early stages of splicing. pmc-12426899.title: Precision in Action: Using Intracardiac Echocardiography for Targeted Removal of a Large Lead‐Related Vegetation in a Patient With Infective Endocarditis
pmc-12426899.creator: Muhammad Memon, Mohamad Sabra, Arfaat A. Khan
pmc-12426899.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLead‐related infective endocarditis is a serious complication of implantable cardioverter‐defibrillators (ICDs), especially in patients with advanced heart failure who are poor surgical candidates. Management of large lead‐associated vegetations remains a clinical challenge.MethodsWe present the case of a 54‐year‐old woman with ischemic cardiomyopathy and recurrent ICD complications who developed bacteremia and infective endocarditis with vegetations on the aortic valve and a 1.5 × 1.3 cm mass on the right ventricular lead.

pmc-12595098.title: Unifying graph neural networks causal machine learning and conformal prediction for robust causal inference in rail transport systems
pmc-12595098.creator: Mehmet Taciddin Akçay
pmc-12595098.description: Modeling the operational dynamics of intricate rail transit systems faces three significant challenges: addressing network-wide dependencies, differentiating correlation from causation, and accurately quantifying prediction uncertainty. Current methodologies generally tackle these issues separately, resulting in models that are either structurally simplistic, causally unclear, or overly confident in their forecasts.

pmc-13148097.title: Benzoxazine-based innovations in shielding: enhancing durability and protection in electronics and clothing
pmc-13148097.creator: Ayisha A. M. Arishi, Khalid A. Alamry, Mahmoud A. Hussein
pmc-13148097.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Benzoxazine-based materials have attracted increasing attention for electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding due to their excellent thermal stability, mechanical strength, low moisture absorption, and dimensional stability. This review presents a comprehensive overview of recent advances in benzoxazine-based nanocomposites for EMI shielding applications, with particular emphasis on the role of conductive and functional nanofillers, including multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs), carbon fibers, Ti₃C₂ MXenes, nanoclays, and epoxy-based hybrid systems.

uslaw-usc-t11-s1190.title: 11 U.S.C. § 1190 — Contents of plan
uslaw-usc-t11-s1190.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t11-s1190.description: United States Code, Title 11 (Bankruptcy); Chapter 11 (Reorganization); Subchapter V (Small Business Debtor Reorganization). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A plan filed under this subchapter— (1) shall include— (A) a brief history of the business operations of the debtor; (B) a liquidation analysis; and (C) projections with respect to the ability of the debtor to make payments under the proposed plan.
